narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the dating app 'Omi' by using a humorous skit about a 'love-brain' friend who overinterprets small signals from a crush. The video uses exaggerated comedic performance to highlight the uncertainty of dating, then provides the app as a solution for better compatibility through its tagging system.
